title: MEP Service Closeout Exceptions: Warranty Work, Callbacks, Missing Parts, and Customer Sign-Off
summary: Handle the MEP closeout cases that require service judgment before an AI-prepared packet reaches billing.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


MEP closeout exceptions should be organized around decisions that an agent cannot safely infer: warranty eligibility, callback classification, unclear parts usage and missing customer acceptance. A Genie can collect the relevant visit and agreement evidence, compare statements and draft an owned review task. Keep the original technician record visible. The agent should not classify every return visit as warranty, interpret a signature as unlimited approval, or make up an item code to finish a billing packet.


Explore the complete[commercial HVAC, plumbing and electrical contractors integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/construction/commercial-mep-contractors) for the systems and processes around this guide.
